hall_roll.title: Bronze Roll of Commanders
hall_roll.text: A bronze roll of the Keep’s commanders, name after name down the ages. The last is cut out of the metal with a chisel, so deeply the wall behind is scarred. Someone has scratched beside it: “He was the best of us.”

hall_mural.title: Mural — The Muster
hall_mural.text: A faded mural: rank on rank of armored Templars kneeling before a commander whose sword is raised against a sky of black stars. Beneath it, in worn script: “We hold the Hold. Not for glory, but so that nothing below ever walks above.”

hall_armory.title: Armory Ledger
hall_armory.text:
“Wards re-lit at dusk. Blades blessed. The Commander refused rest again; he stands vigil over the Hold’s seal every night. He says he can hear it.”

The next page is torn out.

hall_barracks.title: A Soldier’s Last Entry
hall_barracks.text: “The Commander does not sleep. His armor is cold to the touch and his eyes do not catch the lamplight. We were told to wait for orders. No one has given an order in three days.”

hall_chapel.title: Memorial Slab
hall_chapel.text:
“Here lie those who held the gate the night the Commander turned.”

Dozens of names are carved below. Every one is dated the same night.

cl_records.title: Templar Records
cl_records.text:
Water-stained records, in a clerk’s hand:

“The power beneath the Hold answered him. He called it the last ward; it called him by his name. By the third night he could no longer be told from it. We could not kill him — steel passed through him as through smoke.”

The Wraith Lord was a Templar commander, corrupted by the Demon Hold.

cl_inscription.title: Inscription at the Statue
cl_inscription.text:
Carved beneath a statue with no face:

“The commander would not lay down his blade. So we bound his name beneath the dead.”

cl_mural.title: Mural — The Binding
cl_mural.text: A mural of the Binding: Templars chain a tall armored figure while a shaft of dark light waits below. Beneath, a sarcophagus under seven wards and a long stair: the Defiler’s Tomb, sealed under the Dark Crypt.

cl_graves.title: The Cloister Graves
cl_graves.text: Rows upon rows of graves. Every stone carries a Templar’s name and the same epitaph: “He did not die. He was taken.”

cl_cell1.title: Scratched Into a Cell Wall
cl_cell1.text: “They put Brother Halvard here for saying the Commander was still alive in the tomb. Brother Halvard was right.”

cl_cell2.title: A Ledger Left in a Cell
cl_cell2.text: “The Defiler’s Tomb was sealed with his name. Names can be unsaid. A thief with a pry bar need only say the right words — or none at all.”

cl_sanct.title: The Desecrated Sanctuary
cl_sanct.text:
The altar has been overturned and carved over with demon sigils. Fresh wax, old blood. A torn page in the dust:

“The grave robber broke the seal. The essence is free. He has come home to finish what the Hold began.”

tp_wards.title: Overwritten Wards
tp_wards.text: Old Templar ward-marks line the nave, each overwritten by a demon glyph, carved deep and recently. The glyphs do not oppose the wards. They invert them.

tp_tome.title: A Cultist’s Liturgy
tp_tome.text: “Three to bind, three to loose. The Commander speaks through the stones, and beneath the stones the Door answers. It opens at the ninth bell.”

tp_mural.title: Cracked Mural
tp_mural.text: Three bearers stand at three sockets. Beneath them, in newer paint, a door is opening outward.

tp_altar.title: The Sanctum Altar
tp_altar.text:
Three sockets in the altar: a shield, a sword, a cross.

The Wraith Lord has been using the awakened Runestones to reverse the ritual that bound the Hold. The ritual is already mostly complete. Below, the Demon Hold is opening.

Your path is clear: descend into the Demon Hold and stop him.

dg_wards.title: A Severed Ward-Pylon
dg_wards.text: The Templar ward-pylons along this passage were not worn down. They were cut through, cleanly, at the base, by someone who knew exactly where each one was weakest.

dg_cells.title: Scratched Into a Cell Door
dg_cells.text: “The wraiths do not guard the prisoners. There are no prisoners. They guard what lies beneath the cells.”

dg_crypt.title: Defiled Crypt Plaque
dg_crypt.text:
“Rest them. Do not wake them. Do not let them be woken.”

The plaque has been struck from the wall and the sarcophagi beneath it stand open. The Templar dead walk the Keep now.

dg_chains.title: The Chains
dg_chains.text: Heavy chains run down the tunnel into the dark, every link inscribed with a ward. They were forged to hold something in. Now every ward on them has been inverted, and the chains pull the other way: they are carrying something up.

dg_machine.title: Ritual Machinery
dg_machine.text: Templar engineers built this machine to draw the Hold’s dark power into the earth and bind it there. Someone has turned every gear about. It no longer binds. It pours, and the breach beyond is wider for every turn.

dg_late.title: The Last Entry
dg_late.text: A Templar’s hand, shaking: “If you are reading this, the Door is already open. We were too few. Go down. The old altar still stands in the Hold. Do not let the stones fall into his hands, and do not let him finish.”

hd_gate.title: Inscription Over the Hold Gate
hd_gate.text: “Here the Templars held the dark, and here they fell. Let whoever follows hold it better.”

hd_altar.title: The Templar Altar
hd_altar.text:
A stone altar at the mouth of the Hold, three sockets worn smooth: the shield that guards, the sword that strikes, the cross that binds. A Templar has scratched into its base:

“The dark cannot be destroyed. So we gave it one door to leave by, and we sat down in front of it. If the Door opens, the three stones go here. Then it can only open one way.”

1: A scout’s journal lies by the brazier: “Lights in the far east keep. Black ones. Something lives in Shadow Keep, and it is not the Templars.” The first span of the skybridge shivers and hardens into light.
2: Scratched into the brazier: “The soldiers in the east keep walk without breath. Cultists drive them. Shadow has taken them whole.” The second span of the skybridge answers.
3: A broken Templar standard bears a last warning: “When the stones answer, the Hold shall open.” The final span of the skybridge ignites, and Highward’s gate groans wide.

HIDDEN_SECRETS_DESC.toOldMan: You found a Ruins Map in the Dark Crypt. Bring it to Aldric the Elder.
HIDDEN_SECRETS_DESC.toRuins: Aldric the Elder says the map points to the Lakeside Ruins. Take the Ruins Map to the ancient stones on the island at the lake's center.
HIDDEN_SECRETS_DESC.explore: Descend to the bottom (level 5) of the Ancient Ruins beneath Lakeside Ruins and open the chest.
HIDDEN_SECRETS_DESC.complete: You found the Defensive Runestone. Take it to the sealed gate at the end of the Mountain Pass road (Frosthold Keep).
